params.name: page
params.description:
The page number for [paginated results](/products/payments-odl/api-docs/ripplenet/best-practices/pagination/). The value is zero-based, where `0` represents the first page.
Set it to `0` to get the first page of results.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of objects to return per page.

items.docs:
Execute an exchange transfer to move funds from one of your accounts in one currency (USD, for example) to another one of your accounts in another currency (EUR, for example) at an exchange rate set by your peer who maintains both of your accounts on their ledger. An exchange transfer enables you to fund a foreign currency account from your domestic currency account in bulk.

Before you make this request, you may want to use the Quote Exchange Transfer request to see a quote for the exchange tra
Requests a quote for an exchange transfer.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the exchange transfer to complete.

items.docs: Updates the status of an exchange transfer to `COMPLETED`. Make this request once the exchange transfer has been made on both the ledger and on internal systems.
